theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (Φ : Eucl n → Eucl P) (Ω : Set (Eucl n)) (h : Eucl n → ℝ), IsOpen Ω → ContDiff ℝ 1 Φ → (∀ w ∈ Ω, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ Φ w)) → ∃ γ : Eucl n → Eucl P, Measurable γ ∧ ∀ w ∈ Ω, γ w ∈ LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ Φ w).toLinearMap ∧ ∀ u : Eucl n, inner ℝ (γ w) (fderiv ℝ Φ w u) = fderiv ℝ h w u
